# luxslime / momiji products (full)

English-only product listing for LLM crawlers. Concise catalog of earn-first Apify Actors and Shopify apps.

Site: https://apify.momiji-space.com/

This file does not include prices, ratings, or install counts.

## Apify Actors

Publisher username: taroyamada
Each Actor below has an Apify Store URL, a short Markdown mirror, and the existing HTML landing page.

### apple-podcast-scraper
Name: Apple Podcasts / iTunes Scraper
JTBD: Scrape Apple Podcasts / iTunes show and episode metadata for research or monitoring.
Purpose: Keyword search, chart snapshots, episode metadata, and watchlists via public Apple/iTunes endpoints. This is the search, episode, and watchlist Actor — not rank-movement reports and not Customer Reviews RSS.
URL: https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-scraper
Mirror: https://apify.momiji-space.com/apple-podcast-scraper.md
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/apple-podcasts-scraper/

### article-content-extractor
Name: Article Content Extractor
JTBD: Extract clean article body and content from web pages at scale.
Purpose: Parse public news, blog, newsroom, and press URLs into headline, byline, publish date, and article body. HTML cleanup for article-shaped URLs you already have; not a search surface.
URL: https://apify.com/taroyamada/article-content-extractor
Mirror: https://apify.momiji-space.com/article-content-extractor.md
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/article-content-extractor/

### g2-capterra-review-intelligence
Name: G2 & Capterra Review Scraper
JTBD: Collect G2 and Capterra reviews for competitor and product intelligence.
Purpose: Read public G2 and Capterra product review pages into ratings, review rows, and pros/cons. Not Shopify App Store listings and not Apple Podcasts reviews.
URL: https://apify.com/taroyamada/g2-capterra-review-intelligence
Mirror: https://apify.momiji-space.com/g2-capterra-review-intelligence.md
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/g2-capterra-review-scraper/

### procurement-intel-actor
Name: SAM.gov, TED & Grants Bid Alerts
JTBD: Monitor SAM.gov, TED, and grants bid opportunities and alerts.
Purpose: Queue TED tenders, SAM.gov opportunities, and Grants.gov notices into source-linked bid alerts with deadline, award-watch, and rebid signals.
URL: https://apify.com/taroyamada/procurement-intel-actor
Mirror: https://apify.momiji-space.com/procurement-intel-actor.md
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/ted-sam-grants-bid-alerts/

### apple-podcast-chart-tracker
Name: Apple Podcasts Chart Scraper
JTBD: Track Apple Podcasts chart rankings and chart metadata by country and category.
Purpose: Snapshot public Apple Podcasts Top Podcasts charts by storefront, with optional movement reports when ranks are new, changed, or dropped. Does not search by keyword or attach episode catalogs.
URL: https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-chart-tracker
Mirror: https://apify.momiji-space.com/apple-podcast-chart-tracker.md
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/apple-podcasts-chart-scraper/

### apple-podcast-reviews-monitor
Name: Apple Podcasts Reviews Scraper
JTBD: Monitor Apple Podcasts reviews over time for shows you care about.
Purpose: Fetch official iTunes Customer Reviews RSS for podcast collection IDs you already have. Snapshot or monitor new/changed reviews; does not search by keyword or snapshot Top Podcasts ranks.
URL: https://apify.com/taroyamada/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor
Mirror: https://apify.momiji-space.com/apple-podcast-reviews-monitor.md
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/apple-podcasts-reviews-scraper/

## Shopify Apps

Live Shopify App Store listings. Merchant landings are linked when this site already publishes one.

### AddressFence (PO Box Blocker)
Listing name: AddressFence: PO Box Guard
JTBD: Block or control PO Box and restricted addresses at checkout and billing.
Purpose: Checkout and billing address rules for PO Box and other restricted address patterns.
URL: https://apps.shopify.com/address-guard

### Prop65 (Prop 65 Warning Manager)
JTBD: Publish California Prop 65 warnings with templates and an audit trail.
Purpose: Display merchant-chosen Prop 65 warning content with cited templates and an audit log. The app does not provide legal advice or guarantee compliance.
URL: https://apps.shopify.com/momiji-prop-65-warning-manager

### B2B (B2B Terms & PO Guard)
JTBD: Require B2B purchase-order numbers and Net terms while keeping D2C checkout open.
Purpose: Validate B2B purchase-order numbers at checkout, work alongside native Net terms, and leave D2C / no-company checkouts untouched.
URL: https://apps.shopify.com/b2b-terms-guard
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/b2b-po-terms/

### Access Audit Guard
JTBD: Audit installed app and staff access scopes, including AI apps that can touch customer data.
Purpose: Review installed-app scopes, staff and collaborator access, and scope/owner drift. First audit runs on install; exportable evidence is available from the live listing.
URL: https://apps.shopify.com/momiji-access-audit
Landing: https://apify.momiji-space.com/access-audit/
